expectations.text: Anchors the security-safeguards penalty to Section 8(5) with the Rs 250 crore Schedule tier
expectations.evidence: Table: "Failure to take reasonable security safeguards ... Section 8(5) ... Rs 250 crore"

expectations.text: States the breach-notification failure tier of Rs 200 crore
expectations.evidence: "Failure to give notice of a personal data breach ... Section 8(6) ... Rs 200 crore"

expectations.text: States voluntary-undertaking breach is Section 32 with the penalty capped at the extent applicable to the underlying breach, not a flat Rs 50 crore
expectations.evidence: "Section 32 ... Up to the extent applicable to the underlying breach for which the undertaking was given (no separate flat cap)"

expectations.text: States Rs 50 crore is the residual tier for other breaches
expectations.evidence: "Any other violation not specifically listed | Section 33 Schedule residual item | Rs 50 crore"

expectations.text: Lists Section 33(2) factors consistent with the statute (nature/gravity/duration, type of data, repetition, gain or loss avoided, mitigation, proportionality and deterrence, likely impact of the penalty) without invented factors
expectations.evidence: Seven factors listed matching the statute exactly: nature/gravity/duration, type of data, repetitive nature, gain/loss avoided, mitigation, proportionate and effective (deterrence), likely impact
